title: Cam Orchestrator Self-Handoff
description: Machine-readable state the long-lived orchestrator session writes when it approaches its token budget (CAM-23), so a fresh orchestrator can rehydrate instead of cold-starting after a silent auto-compaction. Written by the orchestrator agent, read by buildOrchestratorBootPrompt on respawn.

schemaVersion.description: Handoff schema version. The reader rejects unknown versions so a forward-incompatible file is never silently mis-read.

writtenAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the handoff was written.

reason.description: Why the handoff was triggered, e.g. 'token-budget-exceeded'.

projectContext.description: What the project is and where it stands: the durable context a fresh session needs.

currentCycle.description: The issue or cycle currently in flight (id, branch, state).

keyDecisions.description: Decisions made this session worth carrying forward.

openState.description: Open working state: what is in progress, what is staged or pushed, what is pending.

openQuestions.description: Unresolved questions the fresh session should resolve.

nextActions.description: Concrete next steps the fresh orchestrator should take.
